id: title:danielcarletti:stop wiping cdc companion history on redelivery

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse CDC ingestion and SCD2 history preservation
review.reason: Adds boolean parameters `is_initial_load` and `cdc_write_mode` to warehouse CDC ingestion helpers. P1.F1.H2 and P1.F1.H4 establish and propagate an initial-load flag to distinguish snapshot loads from streaming redeliveries, while P1.F3.H1 forwards warehouse-specific write modes. This supports the PostHog warehouse connector's ability to preserve SCD2 history and avoid re-seeding,
review.uncertainty: The chunk lacks the implementation of the helper and the definition of the `cdc_write_mode` attribute, and the reviewer cannot independently verify that the forwarding and mode preservation are actually performed. The tier is assigned based on the presence of the parameter definitions and propagation, not the verified behavior of the downstream helper.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the new helper function `_run_post_load_for_already_processed_batch` or the definition of the `cdc_write_mode` attribute on the signal object. The tests and the call site rely on this missing implementation, so the reviewer cannot independently verify that the forwarding and the mode preservation are actually performed. No score can

observations.behavior: Adds a new boolean parameter `is_initial_load` to the signature of `_run_cdc_post_load` and its caller, and records it in the logger.
observations.posthog_connection: This parameter is used to distinguish an initial snapshot load from a redelivered streaming batch, which is necessary to avoid re-seeding the companion table and wiping SCD2 history.

observations.behavior: Adds a new boolean parameter `is_initial_load` to the signature of `_run_post_load_operations` and its caller, and records it in the logger.
observations.posthog_connection: This parameter is passed downstream to the CDC post-load helper, carrying the initial-load flag established earlier.

observations.behavior: Adds a new boolean parameter `cdc_write_mode` to the call of `_run_post_load_operations`.
observations.posthog_connection: This forwards the warehouse write mode from the signal to the post-load helper, which is required for the downstream CDC-specific seeding and companion registration logic.
